cohort: 766 Israeli women with previous childbirth experience were recruited through social media to complete an online survey.
finding: Women who experienced physiological childbirth had a higher flow state during birth compared to those who had births with epidural anesthesia or instrumental interventions.
mod_finding: Women who experienced physiological childbirth (i.e., with no epidural anesthesia or instrumental interventions) had a higher flow state during birth.
